verdict.rationale: A first-party release note documents the Select AI Agent Framework, which lets you define agent teams in a database schema and grant other users or roles permission to run them. That shows a shipped agent orchestration capability, not just a vision. However, it appears only as a single thin release-note mention, and it is scoped to the database rather than a general managed agent runtime. Missing for 10: a dedicated managed agent runtime/hosting service in evidence, in-depth docs on agent orchestration (deployment, lifecycle, tools, memory, observability), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
